Re-Sync Transaction Categories to Spreadsheets
Please be aware this will overwrite any categories you manually changed in your spreadsheets. Always update categories and rules in Fintable only, if you use spreadsheet integrations.

Although Fintable automatically syncs your transaction categories to Airtable and Google Sheets, sometimes, a manual re-sync might be necessary. Click the buttons below to initiate a re-sync. You will be notified by email when complete.
